worldcombat.skill.protect.summary: Raises a dome on yourself that blocks enemy attacks with a total shield pool; when the pool is spent the dome shatters and the excess still lands. The braced stance roots you while it holds, and repeated use tends to fail.
worldcombat.skill.protect.description.0: Raises a dome on yourself: it lasts %1$s and can block a total of %2$s points of enemy damage; higher defences make it longer, and the pool grows with current health and Defence.
worldcombat.skill.protect.description.2: Repeated use in quick succession is more likely to fail; the current failure chance is %1$s. Braced stance prevents movement while active; instant stance allows it.
worldcombat.skill.protect.use.0: Pre-empt a volley and raise early
worldcombat.skill.protect.use.1: Open a lane out when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.protect.use.2: Buy time for an ally to heal or withdraw
worldcombat.skill.protect.preference.bra: On (brace): duration x1.3, pool x1.15, but recover 10 ticks, cooldown x1.15 and rooted throughout. Off (instant): duration x0.8, pool x0.8, recover only 4 ticks, cooldown x0.85, and you can still move while it holds.
Raise the dome when a threat enters this range. Larger reacts earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but may be too late.
worldcombat.skill.protect.description.po: The shield ends when depleted; damage exceeding its remaining capacity still hits you. It does not protect against self-inflicted damage or environmental damage without an attacker.
